hook.name: useRecordingController
hook.description: Provides cloud-recording status and actions for starting, stopping, pausing, and resuming recordings.
hook.returns: A RecordingController containing current availability and status, loading and control flags, and four asynchronous actions.
notes: canControlRecording is true only while connected, cloud recording is enabled, the current user is a host or co-host/manager, and no action started from this hook call is in progress.
Actions have no effect when recording controls are unavailable or the current recording status does not allow the requested action.

Actions never reject. A failed action shows an error notification that explains the reason when known, such as cloud recording being disabled for the account. isLoading returns to false when the action finishes.

fields.name: recordingStatus
fields.description: Current cloud recording status. Stopped when the status cannot be read, for example when no Video SDK client is available.

fields.name: isCloudRecordingEnabled
fields.description: Whether cloud recording is available for the account and session.

fields.name: isLoading
fields.description: True while an action started from this hook call is in progress. Actions started from other components, including RecordButton, are not included.

fields.name: canControlRecording
fields.description: True when recording controls are usable: connected, cloud recording enabled, you are a host or co-host, and no action from this hook call is in progress. Each action also checks recordingStatus.

fields.name: startRecording
fields.description: Starts cloud recording. No effect while the status is Recording or Paused.

fields.name: stopRecording
fields.description: Stops cloud recording. No effect unless the status is Recording or Paused.

fields.name: pauseRecording
fields.description: Pauses a recording whose status is Recording.

fields.name: resumeRecording
fields.description: Resumes a recording whose status is Paused.

types.name: RecordingStatus
types.description: Cloud recording status enum from the Zoom Video SDK. Import it with `import { RecordingStatus } from '@zoom/videosdk'`.
